title: NT3 Teacher Decision Console — Decisions Export
description: Export of teacher decisions from TEACHER_DECISION_CONSOLE.html. PROPOSALS ONLY: this file never mutates questionbank/registry.jsonl or any source; a later, separate, teacher-gated application step is required. The console presents evidence and records choices; it does not itself decide anything, and no state in this document may ever be described as "verified" — verification, if any, happens outside this file in the gated application step.

schema_version.description: Fixed version tag for this export shape.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the console generated this export. Null is allowed ONLY in the blank template (teacher_decisions.template.json) prior to any export; a real export from the console always sets this.

reviewer_default.description: Optional reviewer id typed into the console's reviewer field, used to prefill each decision's `reviewer` unless overridden per-decision.

note.description: Optional free-form note about the export as a whole (not tied to any single decision).

decisions.description: One entry per teacher decision recorded in the console, across sections 1-5. May be empty (e.g. the blank template, or an export before any decisions were made).

section.description: Which of the console's 6 sections this decision belongs to (section 6 is the export mechanism itself and produces no decisions of its own): 1=4-1 revive-vs-retire, 2=DOK-conflict pairs, 3=flagged figures from the 64-figure contact sheet, 4=essential missing visuals, 5=DOK acceptance rubric v0.1-PROPOSED.

decision_id.description: Stable identifier for this decision, namespaced by section. Conventions: section 1 uses a single fixed id 's1-revive-or-retire-4-1'; section 2 uses 's2-<legacy_id>', one per DOK-conflict pair (e.g. 's2-5-4-savvas-q41' — the sole DOK 2-vs-3 conflict pair; all other pairs conflict on other DOK values); section 3 uses 's3-fig-<bank_id>' for the two teacher-flagged figures ('s3-fig-4-3-ex-6', 's3-fig-6-4-savvas-q30'); section 4 uses 's4-<legacy_id>-L<registry_line>' for the 14 essential missing visuals, where the L<registry_line> suffix disambiguates cases like the duplicated legacy id '5-4-savvas-q18' which appears at registry lines 276 and 307; section 5 uses the fixed id 's5-rubric-v0.1'. Legacy ids embedded in decision_id are for human readability only — see target_item_uids for the authoritative identity key.

target_item_uids.description: The item(s) this decision applies to, keyed by item_uid — the ONLY valid identity key in this system. Each entry MUST match the opaque uid format '^iu_[0-9a-f]{12}$'; legacy/bank ids (e.g. '5-4-savvas-q41') are display-only convenience labels, are NOT unique (85 legacy ids are shared by two separate registry rows), and will FAIL this pattern if submitted here. Global (lesson- or rubric-scoped) actions may leave this empty; item-scoped actions require at least one uid — see the if/then/else conditional below for exactly which actions require it.

registry_lines.description: 1-based line numbers into questionbank/registry.jsonl that this decision touches. Global (lesson- or rubric-scoped) actions may leave this empty (e.g. the section 5 rubric decision, which concerns the rubric document rather than a specific registry row); item-scoped actions require at least one line — see the if/then/else conditional below for exactly which actions require it.

action.description: The teacher's chosen action for this decision. Valid actions are grouped by section: Section 1 (4-1 revive-vs-retire): revive-ingestion-only | revive-full-rebuild | retire-and-repoint | defer. Section 2 (DOK-conflict pairs, 22 pairs): keep-both | reconcile-labels | merge-candidate | needs-source-check — all four are EQUAL options; none is a default or recommended choice. Section 3 (flagged figures, e.g. the 2 teacher-flagged figures isolated from the 64-figure contact sheet): confirm | reject | needs-rework. Section 4 (14 essential missing visuals): provide-source | accept-gap | reclassify. Section 5 (DOK acceptance rubric v0.1-PROPOSED): approve-rubric | request-changes | defer. Note 'defer' is shared by sections 1 and 5. The schema DOES enforce a coarser split of this same grouping via the decision object's if/then/else: {revive-ingestion-only, revive-full-rebuild, retire-and-repoint, defer, approve-rubric, request-changes} are 'global' (section 1 + section 5) and may have empty target_item_uids/registry_lines; every other action here is 'item-scoped' (section 2, 3, 4) and requires at least one target_item_uids entry and one registry_lines entry.

params.description: Optional structured parameters, only meaningful for specific actions.

chosen_dok.description: Required semantics (by rubric convention, not enforced by this schema): present only when action is 'reconcile-labels'. Names the authoritative DOK level for a conflicting pair; BOTH registry rows stay in the registry unchanged — this only records which DOK label the teacher considers correct going forward. Not applicable to any other action.

rubric_version.description: Version tag for the DOK acceptance rubric this decision concerns, e.g. 'v0.1-PROPOSED'. Used on section 5 decisions. The 'PROPOSED' suffix reflects that the rubric is not yet teacher-approved; nothing may be recorded as 'verified' against it until approval, and this schema never uses the word 'verified' to describe any recordable state.

target_ambiguous.description: Set true when this decision's legacy id maps to two registry rows (an ambiguous alias in inventory/dedup/item_uid_alias_map.json) and BOTH candidate item_uids are included in target_item_uids rather than silently pinning one. As of this writing, 4 staged-figure legacy ids are ambiguous in the alias map: '5-1-savvas-q45', '5-1-savvas-q48', '5-4-savvas-q44', '5-5-savvas-q36'.

reviewer.description: Identifier (name/initials/id) of the teacher/reviewer who made this decision. Prefilled from reviewer_default if the console offers that convenience, but recorded per-decision here.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time when this specific decision was made in the console. Null only for decisions not yet made (e.g. in a blank/partial template).

note.description: Free-form rationale for this decision. Optional in this schema, but REQUIRED BY RUBRIC (not by this schema) whenever the teacher's choice disagrees with the console's evidence/recommendation or changes a prior decision — the schema intentionally does not enforce this so the console can still export partial/in-progress work, but reviewers should treat a missing note on a disagreement or change as incomplete.

then.description: Global (lesson- or rubric-scoped) action — section 1 (4-1 revive-vs-retire) and section 5 (rubric) decisions. target_item_uids and registry_lines are allowed to be empty because these actions apply to a lesson or a rubric document as a whole, not to individual registry rows.

else.description: Item-scoped action — every action outside the global set (keep-both, reconcile-labels, merge-candidate, needs-source-check, confirm, reject, needs-rework, provide-source, accept-gap, reclassify). These name specific registry row(s), so at least one item_uid and one registry line are required.
